verdict.rationale: The firm's own IP page says it handles patent disputes and trademark enforcement, which shows a first-party IP dispute practice. However, its pages name no courts, venues, case outcomes or trade-secret litigation, so only a thin mention supports the story. Missing for 10: named courts or forums where IP matters were litigated, described case outcomes or representative matters, trade-secret dispute coverage, independent corroboration.
